title: Walking Someone Else's Dog
sentences: My neighbour broke her ankle in October and could not walk her dog for two months.
I offered to take him out, although I had never owned a dog myself.
He is large, friendly and completely uninterested in anything I tell him.
For the first week he pulled me along the whole length of the street.
A woman in the park eventually showed me how to hold the lead properly.
After that things improved, at least most of the time.
I have come to enjoy the walks a good deal more than I expected to.
I notice things in the neighbourhood that I used to drive straight past.
My neighbour is walking again, so my job has ended.
I still look for him whenever I pass her window.
